members.doc: Given a sequence of path names, returns the longest common sub-path.

members.doc: Given a list of pathnames, returns the longest common leading component

members.name: dirname
members.doc: Returns the directory component of a pathname

members.name: exists
members.doc: Test whether a path exists. Returns False for broken symbolic links

members.name: expanduser
members.doc: Expand ~ and ~user constructions. If user or $HOME is unknown, do nothing.

members.name: expandvars
members.doc: Expand shell variables of form $var and ${var}. Unknown variables are left unchanged.

members.name: getatime
members.doc: Return the last access time of a file, reported by os.stat().

members.name: getctime
members.doc: Return the metadata change time of a file, reported by os.stat().

members.name: getmtime
members.doc: Return the last modification time of a file, reported by os.stat().

members.name: getsize
members.doc: Return the size of a file, reported by os.stat().

members.name: isabs
members.doc: Test whether a path is absolute

members.name: isdir
members.doc: Return true if the pathname refers to an existing directory.

members.name: isfile
members.doc: Test whether a path is a regular file

members.name: isjunction
members.doc: Test whether a path is a junction Junctions are not a part of posix semantics

members.name: islink
members.doc: Test whether a path is a symbolic link

members.name: ismount
members.doc: Test whether a path is a mount point

members.name: lexists
members.doc: Test whether a path exists. Returns True for broken symbolic links

members.name: normcase
members.doc: Normalize case of pathname. Has no effect under Posix

members.name: normpath
members.doc: Normalize path, eliminating double slashes, etc.

members.name: realpath
members.doc: Return the canonical path of the specified filename, eliminating any symbolic links encountered in the path.

members.name: relpath
members.doc: Return a relative version of a path

members.doc: Test whether two stat buffers reference the same file

members.name: split
members.doc: Split a pathname. Returns tuple "(head, tail)" where "tail" is everything after the final slash. Either part may be empty.

members.name: splitdrive
members.doc: Split a pathname into drive and path. On Posix, drive is always empty.

members.name: splitext
members.doc: Split the extension from a pathname. Extension is everything from the last dot to the end, ignoring leading dots. Returns "(root, ext)"; ext may be empty.
